title: No draft-only placeholder for figures: a labelled note could reach readers if published
description: Machines on Machines policy now asks writers to leave a labelled placeholder where a figure belongs. Markus has no directive for that, so the first article uses a note callout titled 'Figure to come'. Nothing stops those going live. Add a placeholder directive that the newsroom preview shows and that publish refuses, along with an illustration step that lists the Story's open placeholders. Relates to PPY-46f122.
